name: UBC Open 2020

venue.name: [AMS Student Nest, UBC](https://www.ams.ubc.ca/the-nest/)
venue.details: The competition will be held in AMS Great Hall and Performance Theatre on the 2nd Floor of the Nest.

information:
This competition was formerly planning on holding 3x3x3 with Feet, but since the event [will no longer be an official WCA event](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/removing-official-status-for-3x3x3-with-feet), it has been removed from the event list and from the schedule.

If you have any other questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.
